_comment: What this engine predicted, written before the outcomes existed. See prediction_record.py. NOT to be regenerated: the value of this file is entirely that it predates what it will be scored against.

coverage.excluded: K, DEF and all IDP positions carry no slot in this league shape and so never reach the board. They are absent from this record, NOT predicted-and-wrong. Any scorer must exclude them rather than count them as misses.
